DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした傘についてですね。最後に見た場所から教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here about a lost umbrella. Please tell me where you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 図書館の入口の傘立てです。帰るとき、自分の傘がなく、よく似た傘が一本残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図書館で自分の傘が消え似た傘が残ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: In the umbrella stand at the library entrance. When I was leaving, mine was gone and one very similar umbrella remained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your umbrella disappeared at the library and a similar one remained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残っていた傘はお持ちではないのですね。ご自身の傘には目印がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not brought the umbrella that remained, correct? Does your own umbrella have any identifying marks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ってきていません。私の傘には持ち手に青いひもがあり、残っていたほうにはありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他の傘は持ち帰らず自分の持ち手には青いひもがあると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not brought it. My umbrella has a blue cord on the handle, but the one left there did not.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you did not take the other umbrella home and your own has a blue cord on its handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 目印があると区別できますね。傘の色と、置いた時刻は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That mark will help distinguish it. Do you remember the umbrella's color and what time you left it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 濃い緑色で、今日の午後一時ごろ置きました。三時に戻ったときにはありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 濃緑色の傘を一時に置き三時に見つからなかったと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is dark green, and I left it around one this afternoon. It was gone when I returned at three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you left a dark green umbrella at one and could not find it at three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図書館の方にも事情を伝えましたか。取り違えて返す方がいるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you also explained what happened to the library staff? Someone who took it by mistake may return it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付に伝え、残っていた傘はそのままにしました。返ってきたら連絡をもらえるか聞いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図書館受付へ報告し返却時の連絡方法を尋ねたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told reception and left the remaining umbrella where it was. I have asked whether they can contact me if mine is returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you reported it to library reception and asked how you could be contacted if it is returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらへの相談でも、その経緯を記録しましょう。ほかに特徴を思い出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record that sequence of events for your report here too. Can you remember any other features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 傘の内側に小さく名字を書いてあります。見つかった候補があれば、ひもと名字で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内側の名字と青いひもで見つかった候補を確かめたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote my surname in small letters inside the umbrella. If a possible match is found, I would like to check the cord and surname.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you would like to identify any possible match by the surname inside and the blue cord. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 特徴を伺いました。相談内容に追加があればまたお知らせください。雨の中、お帰りはお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have noted those features. Please let us know if you have anything to add to your report. Take care going home in the rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達についてですね。この票の日付をご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about redelivery. Could you check the date on this notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週の日付になっています。昨日入っていた票だと思って出しましたが、別のものかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日のつもりで出した票が先週の日付だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is dated last week. I took it out thinking it was the notice left yesterday, but it may be a different one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice you thought was from yesterday is dated last week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先週の荷物はもう受け取りましたか。ほかの票もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already received last week's parcel? Do you have any other notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の荷物は受け取りました。袋の中にもう一枚あります。こちらは昨日の日付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先週分は受取り済みで昨日の日付の別票があると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I received last week's parcel. There is another notice in my bag. This one is dated yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that last week's parcel has arrived and you have another notice dated yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二枚を分けて見ましょう。昨日の票に書かれた配達先はご自身の住所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at the two separately. Is the delivery address on yesterday's notice your own address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所は合っています。ただ、保管に関する欄の字が小さいので、読み方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達先が正しいことを伝え保管欄の読み方を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The address is correct. However, the writing in the storage section is small, so please help me read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the delivery address is correct and ask for help reading the storage section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その欄の内容を一緒に確認します。受け取る方法は、票にある案内から選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check that section together. Let us choose a collection method from the instructions on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家を空ける時間が多いので、窓口で受け取れるかと、その場合の持ち物を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在が多いため窓口受取りの可否と持ち物を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am often away from home, so I would like to check whether I can collect it at a counter and what I would need to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Since you are often away, check whether counter collection is possible and what to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物の種類も確認してからご案内します。受け取り済みの票はどう管理しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the type of parcel before explaining. How will you manage the notice for the parcel already collected?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い票には受け取り済みとメモし、昨日の票と別の袋に入れます。新しい票の案内で方法を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い票に受取り済みを記し新票を分けその案内で方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write “collected” on the old notice and put it in a separate bag from yesterday's notice. I will choose a method using the new notice's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will mark the old notice as collected, separate it from the new one, and follow the new instructions to choose a method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、新しい票の番号から確認しましょう。お受け取りの際も、道中お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start by checking the number on the new notice. Take care on your way to collect the parcel too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードが見つからないというご相談でしたね。今の状況を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were asking about a missing card. Could you tell me the situation now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来る前はなくしたと思っていましたが、今、鞄の内ポケットで見つかりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失と思って来たが内ポケットで見つかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before coming here I thought I had lost it, but I have just found it in the inside pocket of my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came thinking the card was lost but found it in an inside pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つかったのですね。紛失について、すでにどこかへ連絡されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you found it. Have you already contacted anyone about its loss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出発前に銀行の問い合わせ先へ電話しました。何か手続きをしたか、自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀行へ電話したが手続きの状態を把握できていないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I called the bank's inquiry number before leaving. I do not know whether any procedure was carried out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you called the bank but do not know the status of any procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、電話での受付内容を確かめましょう。何時ごろ、どのように伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check what was recorded during the call. Around what time did you call, and what did you say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午前十時ごろ、カードが見当たらないと伝えました。案内を全部聞き取れず、メモも途中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十時ごろ連絡し案内を聞き取れずメモが途中だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around ten this morning, I said I could not find my card. I could not catch all the instructions, and my notes are incomplete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you called around ten, could not understand all the instructions, and have incomplete notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中のメモも役に立ちます。カードが見つかっただけでは、現在の利用状態は判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even incomplete notes can help. Finding the card alone does not tell us its current usage status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。使えると思い込まず、電話のメモを見せて状態の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発見だけで使えると決めず電話メモを示して確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not assume it is usable; I will show you my notes from the call and ask you to check its status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your telephone notes and ask for a status check without assuming finding the card means you can use it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へつなぎます。カードは再びなくさないよう、しまう場所を決めておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will connect you to the person in charge. Please decide where to keep the card so you do not lose it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鞄の中を探し回らないよう、専用のケースに入れます。確認した内容も最後まで書き留めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 専用ケースを使い今回の確認内容を最後までメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put it in a dedicated case so I do not have to search all through my bag. I will also write down everything confirmed this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use a dedicated case and record all the information confirmed this time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当の確認をお待ちください。お帰りの前にケースも確かめてくださいね。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait for the person in charge to check. Before going home, check your case too. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い上げの品について、ご相談ですか。開封したときの様子を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss something you bought? Please tell me what happened when you opened it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った冷蔵の総菜です。家で開けたら、普段と違うにおいがしたので食べずに置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵総菜のにおいが普段と違い食べていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a refrigerated prepared dish I bought yesterday. When I opened it at home it smelled different from usual, so I have left it uneaten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the refrigerated prepared food smelled unusual and you have not eaten it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べてはいないのですね。購入した時刻と、帰宅までの様子は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not eaten it, then. Do you know what time you bought it and what happened before you got home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼ごろ買い、その後に買い物を続けたので、家に着くまで二時間ほどかかりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼の購入後ほかの買い物で帰宅まで二時間かかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bought it around noon and continued shopping afterward, so it took about two hours to get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you bought it at noon and took two hours to get home because you continued shopping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち帰る間の状況も確認が必要ですね。保冷袋は使いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also need to check the conditions while you carried it home. Did you use an insulated bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使っていません。購入後ずっと手提げ袋に入れていたことも含めて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保冷袋を使わず手提げ袋に入れた状況も相談に含める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I would like to include the fact that it stayed in a shopping bag the whole time after purchase when discussing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Include that you used no insulated bag and kept the food in a shopping bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も担当に伝えます。レシートと商品の包装は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the person in charge that too. Do you still have the receipt and product packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートと包装の写真があります。商品そのものを持って来てよいか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートと包装写真があり現物を持参してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the receipt and a photograph of the packaging. I would like to ask first whether I may bring the actual product in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have the receipt and a packaging photo, and ask whether you may bring the product itself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の方法は担当に尋ねます。ここではにおいだけで状態を判断せず、対応を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask the person in charge how it should be checked. Let us confirm how to handle this rather than judge its condition here by smell alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返金してもらえると決めつけず、持参する物と確認の手順を聞いてから動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返金を前提にせず持参物と確認手順を聞くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume I can get a refund. I will ask what to bring and what the checking procedure is before doing anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will ask what to bring and how it will be checked, without taking a refund for granted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お話の内容を担当へ伝えます。お待ちいただきありがとうございます。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your account on to the person in charge. Thank you for waiting. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の案内図をご覧ですね。散歩の後はどちらの入口へ戻られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the park map. Which entrance will you return to after your walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 迎えの車が来るので、この入口に戻りたいです。長く歩くと疲れるため短い道を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えの車のため同じ入口へ戻り疲れない短い道を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A car is coming to pick me up, so I want to return to this entrance. Long walks tire me out, so I am looking for a short route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need to return to the same entrance for your ride and want a short route that will not tire you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 反対側にも入口があります。今いる入口の名前を、図で一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is also an entrance on the opposite side. Let us check the name of your current entrance together on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここは東の入口ですね。友人には公園の入口としか伝えていないので、東と付けて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東入口だと確認して友人への連絡に方角を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the east entrance. I only told my friend “the park entrance,” so I will contact them and add “east.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm this is the east entrance and add the direction when contacting your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待合せが分かりやすくなりますね。休憩する場所も図で見ておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That will make the meeting point clearer. Would you also like to check places to rest on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。このベンチの印まで行きたいです。坂を通らず戻れる道か確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチの印まで坂を通らず戻れるか確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I would like to go as far as this bench symbol. I want to check whether there is a way back without taking a slope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check whether you can return from the bench symbol without using a slope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図では二つの道が合流しています。坂の表示は現地の案内も見てから選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map shows two paths joining. Please also check the signs on site for slopes before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分岐で案内を読み、坂を避けられるか分からなければ、来た道を戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分岐の案内で坂を避けられると分からなければ来た道を戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will read the signs at the fork, and if I cannot tell whether I can avoid the slope, I will go back the way I came.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return the way you came if the signs at the fork do not make clear whether you can avoid a slope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 短い散歩から始められますね。迎えの方が早く着いたときの連絡はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can start with a short walk. How will you arrange contact if the person collecting you arrives early?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話に出られるようにしておきます。早く着いたら散歩を切り上げ、東の入口に戻ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話を受け早い到着なら散歩を終え東入口へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make sure I can answer the phone. I will tell them that if they arrive early, I will end my walk and return to the east entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will answer the phone and, if they arrive early, finish your walk and return to the east entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、入口の位置を覚えてからお出かけください。休みながら、よい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make sure you remember the entrance location before setting off. Enjoy your walk and take breaks along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の前で迷われていますね。目的地の駅名はおわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem unsure at the ticket machine. Do you know the name of your destination station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から建物の名前だけ届きました。この名前と同じ駅があると思ったのですが、画面に出てきません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物の名前で切符の行き先を探している状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend only sent me the building's name. I thought there was a station with the same name, but it does not appear on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are looking for a ticket destination using the building's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物名と駅名が違うこともあります。待ち合わせの案内に、最寄り駅や出口は書いてありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The building and station names can differ. Do the meeting instructions mention the nearest station or an exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメッセージには建物の写真しかありません。駅を確認せずに、近そうな場所の切符を買うのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真だけで降りる駅を推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This message only has a photo of the building. I want to avoid buying a ticket for somewhere that seems nearby without checking the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not guess which station to get off at using only a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。友人の方に、降りる駅の名前を送ってもらえますか。帰りも同じ駅を使う予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That makes sense. Could you ask your friend to send the name of the station where you should get off? Will you use the same station on your return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅名を聞いてみます。帰りは友人の車で別の場所へ行くので、今日は片道の切符だけ考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片道を検討する理由を迎えの車と結びつける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask for the station name. My friend will drive me somewhere else afterward, so I am only considering a one-way ticket today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Connect your reason for considering a one-way ticket with your friend's car ride. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、行き先がわかってから片道の区間を選びましょう。購入時に確認したいことは、ほかにもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us choose the one-way section after we know the destination. Is there anything else you want to check when buying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 支払いの前に、画面の区間が送られてきた駅名と合っているか、一緒に見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の返信と券売機の選択を一致させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before paying, I would like you to look with me and check that the section on the screen matches the station name they send.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the ticket machine selection with your friend's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、確定する前にお声かけください。返事を待つ間は、次の方が操作できるよう、機械の横へ移動しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please call me before confirming. While waiting for a reply, let us move beside the machine so the next person can use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 横で友人の返信を待ちます。駅名が届いたら区間を選び、支払いの前に確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他の利用者を妨げず購入条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait at the side for my friend's reply. Once the station name arrives, I will select the section and ask you to check before payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid obstructing other users and confirm the conditions for your ticket purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 行き先を確かめてからなら落ち着いて購入できますね。待ち合わせに間に合うよう、気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you have checked your destination, you can buy with confidence. Take care on your way and allow time to reach your meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知をご覧になって心配されたのですね。何の日付が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: The notice worried you. Which date concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上に書いてある日付が先週なので、手続きがもう間に合わないと思って来ました。届いたのは昨日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 期限を逃したと思った根拠を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The date at the top is from last week, so I came thinking it was already too late for the procedure. It arrived yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you thought you had missed the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 上の日付の横には発行日とあります。提出期限と同じとは限りませんので、下の案内も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Next to the top date it says “issue date.” That is not necessarily the submission deadline, so let us also look at the instructions below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発行日という言葉を知りませんでした。通知を作った日と、私が対応する期限は別なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知上部の日付だけで遅延と判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not know the term “issue date.” The day the notice was created and the deadline for my response are separate, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not decide you are late based only on the date at the top of the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この通知では下の枠に期限の説明があります。その隣にある担当部署の連絡先も、控えておくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, on this notice the deadline is explained in the lower box. It would also help to note the contact details of the responsible department beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 枠は見つかりましたが、何を提出するのか理解できません。届いた封筒には、記入する紙が二枚入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出対象が不明な状態を明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found the box, but I do not understand what I must submit. There were two sheets to fill in inside the envelope that arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that you do not know which documents must be submitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二枚とも提出するものか、一枚は記入例か、担当部署に確認しましょう。先に両方へ個人情報を書き込む必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check with the responsible department whether both sheets must be submitted or one is a sample. You do not need to enter personal information on both first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 記入例かどうかも見ずに、二枚とも提出するところでした。担当者には、どちらを返すのかと、空欄にしてよい項目があるかを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記入例への不要な個人情報記載を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I nearly submitted both without checking whether one was a sample. I will ask the person in charge which to return and whether any fields can be left blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid entering unnecessary personal information on a sample form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二点をメモしてお渡しします。担当部署へ問い合わせたら、聞いた期限も、通知と照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will write those two questions down for you. When you contact the department, also compare the deadline they tell you with the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発行日で判断せず、返す紙と記入欄、それから提出期限を担当者に確認します。質問のメモを持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙の種類と欄と期限を部署へ質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not judge by the issue date. I will confirm which sheet to return, the fields to fill in, and the submission deadline with the person in charge. I will take the question notes with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the department about the type of sheet, its fields, and the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 封筒の中身も一緒に持参すると伝わりやすいですね。担当の案内を受けてから、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Taking the envelope's contents with you too will make things clearer. Please get the responsible staff's guidance, then take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の途中で手が止まっていますね。書き方で迷っている欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped partway through the medical questionnaire. Are there any fields you are unsure how to complete?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 咳が始まった時間の欄です。昨日薬を飲んだので、その時間を書けばよいのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診票の時間欄を理解するため質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The field for when my cough began. Since I took medicine yesterday, I wondered whether to write that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask a question to understand the time field on the medical questionnaire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄には症状が始まったころを書きます。薬を飲んだ時刻は別に記録しますので、順番に思い出してみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is for around when the symptoms began. We record the time you took medicine separately, so let us recall them in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一昨日の夜から咳が出ています。薬を飲んだのは昨日の朝で、順番を逆に書きそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状開始と薬を飲んだ日を別々に記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have been coughing since the night before last. I took the medicine yesterday morning; I nearly wrote them in the wrong order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Record the symptom onset and the day you took medicine separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その順番を記しておきましょう。飲まれた薬の名前がわかる箱や説明書はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record that order. Do you have the box or instructions showing the name of the medicine you took?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱は家ですが、袋の写真はあります。ただ、名前の最後の文字が切れていて、全部は読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬名を確認できる情報の限界を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The box is at home, but I have a photo of the bag. However, the last character of the name is cut off, so I cannot read the whole name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the limits of the information available to identify the medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読めない部分は推測せず、そのまま写真を見せてください。確認できていない薬名として、担当者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not guess the unreadable part; show the photo as it is. I will tell the person in charge that the medicine name is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真だけで薬の名前を決めないのですね。家族に箱全体の写真を送ってもらい、届いたらお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切れた文字から薬を推定せず補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So we should not identify the medicine from this photo alone. I will ask my family to send a photo of the whole box and show it to you when it arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not infer the medicine from cut-off lettering; obtain additional information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を確認できると助かります。問診票には、ほかに答えにくい項目がありますか。わからない箇所は、わからないと伝えて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: It will help if we can check the photo. Are there any other questions on the form that are difficult to answer? It is fine to say you do not know something.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬の量も自信がないので、覚えていることと不確かなことを分けて書きます。症状の始まりは一昨日の夜です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記憶の確度を医療担当者に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am also unsure about the amount of medicine, so I will distinguish what I remember from what I am uncertain about. My symptoms started the night before last.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the medical staff how certain your memories are. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 時間の違いが整理できましたね。写真が届いたら職員へお声かけください。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have clarified the different times. Please tell a staff member when the photo arrives. Take care and get well soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けの品はカメラですね。拾われた場所は、住所や建物の名前で説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: The item you are handing in is a camera. Can you describe where you found it using an address or building name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所はわかりません。川を渡ってすぐの道で見つけましたが、近くの建物の名前を覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 覚えている橋を基準に相談を始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not know the address. I found it on the road just after crossing the river, but I do not remember nearby building names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Start the discussion using the bridge you remember as a reference point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: わかる範囲で結構です。橋を渡って、左右のどちらへ進みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Just tell me what you know. After crossing the bridge, did you go left or right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右へ曲がりました。青い看板の前ではなく、その先の空き地の入口に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 看板の前ではなく空き地だと特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I turned right. It was not in front of the blue sign; it was lying at the entrance to the vacant lot farther along.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that it was at the vacant lot rather than in front of the sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 橋、看板、空き地の順ですね。地図にしにくければ、位置関係を簡単に描いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the order is bridge, sign, vacant lot. If it is hard to explain on a map, could you draw a simple sketch of their positions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに橋を描いて、右側に看板を置きます。空き地は看板の先です。見つけた所へ丸をつけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地名がなくても位置関係を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will draw the bridge here and put the sign on the right. The vacant lot is beyond the sign. I have circled the place where I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the relative positions even without place names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図を添えて状況を確認します。カメラを拾った時刻と、その後に操作したことがあれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will attach this sketch and check the circumstances. Please tell me when you found the camera and whether you operated it afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝の八時半ごろです。写真を見たり電源を入れたりせず、布に包んで持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カメラを持参するまでの扱いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Around eight thirty this morning. I did not look at photos or turn it on; I wrapped it in cloth and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you handled the camera before bringing it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 操作していないことも記録します。手続きを進めるために、この案内の内容を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also record that you did not operate it. Let us check these instructions together so we can proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読めない項目は書く前に質問します。図の右と左を取り違えていないかも、もう一度確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付記入と位置説明の誤りを防ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about any items I cannot read before writing. I will also check again that I have not confused right and left in the sketch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prevent mistakes in the reception form and location description. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所を丁寧に伝えてくださってありがとうございます。受付の案内を確認したら、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for carefully describing the location. Please check the reception instructions, then take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に関するご相談ですね。いまのお住まいから、同居の皆さんが移られる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about moving. Is everyone in your household planning to move from your current home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 移るのは私だけです。両親は今の家に住み続けるので、家族全員の郵便を動かしたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族全員の郵便変更ではないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I am moving. My parents will continue living at the current house, so I do not want to redirect the whole family's mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are not changing mail delivery for the whole family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人だけの転居ということですね。転居する方を区別して記入する方法を、案内で確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So only you are moving. Let us check the instructions for how to specify which person is moving on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ名字の父宛ての手紙が、新しい家へ来ないか心配です。名前を省略せずに書いたほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名省略による取り違えを防ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am worried that letters for my father, who has the same surname, might come to my new home. Should I write my full name without abbreviating it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Prevent confusion caused by abbreviating your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名字だけでは区別がつかないので、案内の氏名欄を確認して記入してください。変更を始めたい時期もお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: A surname alone is not enough to distinguish you, so please check and fill in the full-name field in the instructions. Have you decided when you want the change to begin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来月の初めに移ります。今日相談しても、今日から変更されると思ってよいのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日の相談が即日の反映か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am moving at the beginning of next month. I want to know whether discussing it today means I can assume the change starts today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether today's inquiry means the change takes effect the same day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込みからの扱いや開始日については、受付の案内で確認が必要です。希望する時期を伝えてから、お申し込みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need to check the reception instructions for how applications are handled and the start date. Please state your desired timing before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 希望日は伝えますが、まだその日から届くと決まったわけではないのですね。申込内容を確認できる方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望日だけで受け取りを予断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will give my preferred date, but it has not yet been decided that deliveries will start then. I also want to ask how I can check the application details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume delivery timing based only on your preferred date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の方法もご案内します。郵便の手続きとは別に、よく届く手紙の差出人へ新住所を知らせる準備はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also explain how to check. Apart from this postal procedure, are you preparing to notify senders of mail you receive frequently of your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社からの書類は直接新住所に送ってほしいので、担当者にも連絡します。父の分は変更しないことを申込み前に見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人宛てだけの変更を確認して進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want company documents sent directly to my new address, so I will also contact the person in charge. Before applying, I will double-check that my father's mail is not being changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the change applies only to mail addressed to you before proceeding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人とご家族の分を分けて整理できましたね。記入内容を確かめてからお申し込みください。お引越しの際はお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have separated your own mail from your family's. Please check the entries before applying. Take care with your move.
